ModMetaData.name: FFF 机械体改装排程修复 / Mech Modification Queue Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复「机械体改装」窗口中同时排入多个同种改件（例如给左右腿各装一条合成肌腱、或连续安装两块抛弃式陶瓷装甲）时，机兵只安装第一个就结束工作并吃掉后续排程的问题。
Fixes the Mech Modification window queue dropping subsequent jobs when multiple installations of the same modification item (e.g. installing two Synthetic Tendons on left/right legs or stacking two Ceramic Plates) are queued together.
